# Keep crashhelper payload placement and Windows file-use checks in sync

Fresh complete three-file53-line Thunderbird packaging patch read. It adds crashhelper to the macOS Contents/MacOS copy list and package payload under MOZ_CRASHREPORTER, and to the Windows PushFilesToCheck list. Current installer and uninstaller consume that list through their file-use checks; it is not a new list of processes to kill or a proof that a crash was captured. Fixed accepted macOS, payload and Windows list retain crashhelper. Later entry 2460 separately adds macOS signing path entries after a signing regression; this packaging landing alone does not establish signing coverage. No installer, package, executable, crash, native build or signing run was performed.

Scope: Crashhelper platform payload and installer integration.
